note: Current entries of the public Heilbronn leaderboard (github.com/tejstead/heilbronn-site, data/canonical), read at the commit and time below. The leaderboard covers the square for n = 3 to 36 and the triangle and convex variants for n = 3 to 35. Every point set was re-evaluated with evaluate.py and verify.py and reproduces the published exact value_fraction; value is the leaderboard's 30-digit decimal. Records there move daily: re-read before claiming anything.
